method: Public official web documentation only; observations paraphrased, no provider login/API, account, quote request or notification

sources.title: DigitalOcean regional availability
sources.observation: App VMs and PostgreSQL listed in NYC3 and SFO3; account stock and actual latency unobserved.

sources.title: DigitalOcean managed database creation
sources.observation: Major 18 listed; latest supported minor provisioned; edition selection permanent. No exact 18.6 entitlement established.

sources.title: DigitalOcean user privileges
sources.observation: Advanced user-name alphabet excludes underscores; new Advanced users have CREATEDB. SQL/API enforcement and scoped administration need proof.

sources.title: DigitalOcean PostgreSQL limits
sources.observation: Published 1/2/4 GiB backends: 22/47/97; no customer superuser. Not a remote measurement.

sources.title: DigitalOcean PostgreSQL features
sources.observation: Managed maintenance updates engine/OS within configured weekly window; a fixed minor cannot be inferred.

sources.title: DigitalOcean PostgreSQL restore
sources.observation: Seven-day provider backups; restore creates new primary; deleting cluster deletes its provider backups. Independent custody unproved.

sources.title: DigitalOcean PostgreSQL security
sources.observation: Trusted sources and full TLS identity verification are documented; private routing alone is insufficient.

sources.title: DigitalOcean managed DB catalog
sources.observation: Listed minimum 4 GiB/2 vCPU/60 GiB example USD 60.90 monthly; not regional checkout quote.

sources.title: DigitalOcean app VM catalog
sources.observation: Listed Regular 4 GiB/2 vCPU/80 GiB example USD 24 monthly; no account eligibility or purchase.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 ownership transfer
sources.observation: Ordinary owner transfer needs CREATEDB and ability to SET ROLE to new owner; administrative path needs full review.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 role attributes
sources.observation: Non-superuser role creator receives automatic ADMIN membership and cannot remove that automatic grant itself; conflicts with zero-membership replay check under ordinary semantics.

sources.title: DigitalOcean Standard plan lifecycle notice
sources.observation: New Standard plans limited to 4 GiB/no standby or read-only nodes from October 15 for previously unused accounts and November 30 for all accounts in 2026. Account state not inspected.

sources.title: DigitalOcean cluster notifications
sources.observation: Automatic team emails cannot be disabled/customized. No cluster/account/recipient action; future authorization must address these effects.

sources.title: DigitalOcean extension catalog
sources.observation: Edition-specific extension support; listing does not establish installed versions or permission.

sources.title: AWS RDS PostgreSQL administration
sources.observation: rds_superuser is not PostgreSQL superuser; do not assume managed-admin bootstrap equivalence.

sources.title: AWS RDS PostgreSQL pricing
sources.observation: Topology-specific costing required; no comparable AWS quote or provider selection obtained.
